bundle.shortDescription: Local-first, real-time interview copilot for your desktop.
bundle.longDescription: Lodestar is a local-first desktop interview copilot. It listens to a call, transcribes both sides with speaker attribution, and answers questions on the spot as short spoken lines, from a discreet overlay. Cloud answering and transcription are opt-in, and a fully on-device mode is available.
